数据展示

虚拟表格 AsamTableV2

在固定视窗内展示较大的数据集，只渲染可见行。

使用场景 ​

在固定视窗内展示较大的数据集，只渲染可见行。

契约与组合 ​

columns 是渲染列定义，data 是宿主数据；width / height 必须是实际视窗尺寸。 完整说明。

此入口渲染公开 原生虚拟表格，透传全部原生 props、监听器和 slots，并通过公开 ref 转发实例方法与 live 对象。 完整说明。

选择、编辑、过滤、排序、合并与动态树由 renderer / slots 和宿主状态组合承接。 完整说明。

合并使用 row slot 的 cells，复制 VNode 后设置宽高；不要改传入的 cells。 完整说明。

scrollTo / scrollToLeft / scrollToTop / scrollToRow 是公开滚动方法。 完整说明。

组合能力与类型 ​

第一列复选框通过 cellRenderer 与宿主选择状态组合，renderers 完整示例同时包含表头全选及半选；不要假定 TableV2 自带 Table 的选择列注册机制。 完整说明。

原生 slot 与声明边界 ​

固定 2.14.7 的 #cell scope 不包含 cellData，使用 rowData 与 column 读取业务值；column.cellRenderer 回调则有计算后的 cellData。两条路径的参数不同，本入口分别保留原生类型与透传行为。

原生实例 $props 类型未声明 onUpdate:expandedRowKeys 监听器键，运行时仍会触发 update:expandedRowKeys。 完整说明。

受控排序与覆盖层 ​

注意：固定版本首次排序事件可能返回 undefined，受控排序须兼容该值。 完整说明。

基础用法与状态 ​

基础用法与状态

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="virtual-table-host">
		<AsamAutoResizer>
			<template #default="{ width, height }">
				<AsamTableV2
					v-bind="{ width, height, columns, data: rows, rowKey: 'id', rowHeight: 40 }"
				/>
			</template>
		</AsamAutoResizer>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2BasicDemo' });
import { AsamAutoResizer, AsamTableV2, AsamTableV2Alignment } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableV2Columns } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	count: number;
}
const columns: AsamTableV2Columns<Row> = [
	{ key: 'name', dataKey: 'name', title: '名称', width: 180 },
	{ key: 'count', dataKey: 'count', title: '数量', width: 100, align: AsamTableV2Alignment.RIGHT }
];
const rows: Row[] = Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, index) => ({
	id: index,
	name: '本地记录 ' + (index + 1),
	count: index + 1
}));
</script>

<style scoped>
.virtual-table-host {
	height: 240px;
	width: 100%;
}
</style>

四档视觉尺寸与原生行高 ​

四档视觉尺寸与原生行高

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<label>
		ASAM 视觉尺寸
		<AsamSelect v-model="size">
			<AsamOption v-for="item in sizes" :key="item" :value="item" :label="item">
				{{ item }}
			</AsamOption>
		</AsamSelect>
	</label>
	<p class="example-paragraph">原生 rowHeight 保持 50；ASAM 四档只改变视觉 tokens。</p>
	<AsamTableV2
		aria-label="四档视觉尺寸示例"
		:size="size"
		:width="360"
		:height="220"
		:columns="columns"
		:data="rows"
	/>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2DensityDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamTableV2 } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamControlSize, AsamTableV2Columns } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const sizes = ['large', 'big', 'default', 'small'] as const;
const size = ref<AsamControlSize>('default');
const columns: AsamTableV2Columns<unknown> = [
	{ key: 'name', dataKey: 'name', title: '名称', width: 300 }
];
const rows = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, id) => ({ id, name: `记录 ${id + 1}` }));
</script>

<style scoped>
p:where(.example-paragraph) {
	margin-block: 16px;
	line-height: 1.8;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

固定与分组、排序过滤和状态组合 ​

固定与分组、排序过滤和状态组合

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="demo-root-layout">
		<label>
			筛选名称
			<AsamInput v-model="query" />
		</label>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="empty">空数据</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="loading">显示覆盖层</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="primary" @click="compact = !compact">
			调整容器宽度
		</AsamButton>
		<div :style="{ width: compact ? '480px' : '640px', height: '340px', maxWidth: '100%' }">
			<AsamAutoResizer>
				<template #default="{ width, height }">
					<AsamTableV2
						:columns="columns"
						:data="empty ? [] : displayed"
						:fixed-data="empty ? [] : [sticky]"
						:width="width"
						:height="height"
						:header-height="[30, 40]"
						:footer-height="36"
						:sort-state="sortState"
						:row-event-handlers="rowEvents"
						:row-class="rowClass"
						row-key="id"
						@column-sort="sort"
						@scroll="scroll = `${$event.scrollTop}:${$event.scrollLeft}`"
						@end-reached="endReached++"
					>
						<template #header="scope"><GroupHeader v-bind="scope" /></template>
						<template #footer>
							<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">
								共 {{ displayed.length }} 行；滚动 {{ scroll }}；触底
								{{ endReached }}
								<span data-testid="v2-sort-source">
									最近排序请求 {{ lastSortRequest }}
								</span>
							</p>
						</template>
						<template #empty><p class="example-paragraph">没有匹配的记录</p></template>
						<template v-if="loading" #overlay>
							<div class="ui030-loading-overlay" role="status">正在加载本地记录</div>
						</template>
					</AsamTableV2>
				</template>
			</AsamAutoResizer>
		</div>
	</div>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2LayoutStatesDemo' });
import { computed, h, ref } from 'vue';
import type { FunctionalComponent } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamInput,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamAutoResizer,
	AsamTableV2,
	AsamTableV2FixedDir,
	AsamTableV2Placeholder,
	AsamTableV2SortOrder
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamTableV2Columns,
	AsamTableV2CustomizedHeaderSlotParam,
	AsamTableV2ColumnSortParams,
	AsamTableV2SortState,
	AsamTableV2RowEventHandlers,
	AsamTableV2RowClassNameGetter
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	count: number;
	detail: string;
}
const rows = ref<Row[]>(
	Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, id) => ({
		id,
		name: `记录 ${id + 1}`,
		count: 100 - id,
		detail: `记录 ${id + 1} 的完整说明`
	}))
);
const sticky: Row = { id: -1, name: '固定汇总行', count: 5050, detail: '始终位于表头下方' };
const columns: AsamTableV2Columns<unknown> = [
	{
		key: 'name',
		dataKey: 'name',
		title: '名称',
		width: 180,
		sortable: true,
		fixed: AsamTableV2FixedDir.LEFT
	},
	{ key: 'count', dataKey: 'count', title: '数量', width: 120, sortable: true },
	{ key: 'detail', dataKey: 'detail', title: '说明', width: 300 },
	{ key: 'id', dataKey: 'id', title: '编号', width: 100, fixed: AsamTableV2FixedDir.RIGHT }
];
const query = ref('');
const empty = ref(false);
const loading = ref(false);
const compact = ref(false);
const hovered = ref(-2);
const scroll = ref('0:0');
const endReached = ref(0);
const sortState = ref<AsamTableV2SortState>({});
const lastSortRequest = ref('未触发');
const displayed = computed(() => rows.value.filter((row) => row.name.includes(query.value)));
function sort({ key, order }: AsamTableV2ColumnSortParams<unknown>): void {
	lastSortRequest.value = `${String(key)}:${String(order)}`;
	// Native 2.14.7 can emit undefined for a column absent from controlled sortState.
	const nextOrder = order ?? AsamTableV2SortOrder.ASC;
	sortState.value = { [key]: nextOrder };
	rows.value.sort((a, b) => {
		const difference =
			key === 'count'
				? a.count - b.count
				: a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'zh-CN', { numeric: true });
		return nextOrder === AsamTableV2SortOrder.ASC ? difference : -difference;
	});
}
const rowEvents: AsamTableV2RowEventHandlers = {
	onMouseenter: ({ rowIndex }) => {
		hovered.value = rowIndex;
	},
	onMouseleave: () => {
		hovered.value = -2;
	}
};
const rowClass: AsamTableV2RowClassNameGetter<unknown> = ({ rowIndex }) =>
	rowIndex === hovered.value ? 'ui030-hovered' : rowIndex % 2 ? 'ui030-striped' : '';
const GroupHeader: FunctionalComponent<AsamTableV2CustomizedHeaderSlotParam> = ({
	cells,
	columns: current,
	headerIndex
}) => {
	if (headerIndex === 1) return cells;
	return current.map((column, index) =>
		column.placeholderSign === AsamTableV2Placeholder
			? cells[index]
			: h(
					'div',
					{ class: 'el-table-v2__header-cell', style: { width: `${column.width}px` } },
					column.fixed ? '固定区' : '记录信息'
				)
	);
};
</script>

场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="demo-root-layout">
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">
			选中 {{ rows.filter((row) => row.checked).length }} 行；首行 {{ rows[0].name }}
		</p>
		<AsamButton
			native-type="submit"
			type="primary"
			@click="table?.scrollToRow(rows.length - 1, 'end')"
		>
			查看最后一行
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="default" @click="table?.scrollToRow(0, 'start')">
			返回首行
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamTableV2
			ref="table"
			:columns="columns"
			:data="rows"
			:width="640"
			:height="260"
			row-key="id"
			:row-height="44"
			:scrollbar-always-on="true"
		/>
	</div>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2RenderersDemo' });
import { computed, h, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamTableV2, AsamTableV2FixedDir } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableV2Columns, AsamTableV2Expose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import SelectionCell from './SelectionCell.vue';
import EditorCell from './EditorCell.vue';
import type { Row } from './Row.js';
const rows = ref<Row[]>(
	Array.from({ length: 200 }, (_, id) => ({
		id,
		name: `记录 ${id + 1}`,
		checked: false,
		editing: false
	}))
);
const table = ref<AsamTableV2Expose>();
const drafts = new Map<number, string>();
const columns = computed<AsamTableV2Columns<unknown>>(() => [
	{
		key: 'selection',
		width: 60,
		fixed: AsamTableV2FixedDir.LEFT,
		headerCellRenderer: () =>
			h(SelectionCell, {
				label: '选择所有记录',
				checked: rows.value.every((row) => row.checked),
				indeterminate:
					rows.value.some((row) => row.checked) &&
					!rows.value.every((row) => row.checked),
				onChange: (checked: boolean) =>
					rows.value.forEach((row) => {
						row.checked = checked;
					})
			}),
		cellRenderer: ({ rowData }: { rowData: Row }) =>
			h(SelectionCell, {
				label: `选择记录 ${rowData.id + 1}`,
				checked: rowData.checked,
				onChange: (checked: boolean) => {
					rowData.checked = checked;
				}
			})
	},
	{
		key: 'name',
		dataKey: 'name',
		title: '名称（点击编辑）',
		width: 360,
		cellRenderer: ({ rowData }: { rowData: Row }) =>
			h(EditorCell, {
				label: `编辑记录 ${rowData.id + 1}`,
				value: rowData.name,
				editing: rowData.editing,
				onStart: () => {
					drafts.set(rowData.id, rowData.name);
					rowData.editing = true;
				},
				onChange: (value: string) => {
					rowData.name = value;
				},
				onFinish: () => {
					rowData.editing = false;
					drafts.delete(rowData.id);
				},
				onCancel: () => {
					rowData.name = drafts.get(rowData.id) ?? rowData.name;
					rowData.editing = false;
					drafts.delete(rowData.id);
				}
			})
	},
	{ key: 'id', dataKey: 'id', title: '稳定行键', width: 140 }
]);
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamInput, type AsamInputExpose, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { nextTick, ref, watch } from 'vue';
const props = defineProps<{ value: string; label: string; editing: boolean }>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ change: [value: string]; start: []; finish: []; cancel: [] }>();
const input = ref<AsamInputExpose>();
watch(
	() => props.editing,
	async (value) => {
		if (value) {
			await nextTick();
			input.value?.focus();
		}
	}
);
function change(value: unknown) {
	if (typeof value === 'string') emit('change', value);
}

跨行列悬停 ​

cellProps 在每个单元格附加宿主的 mouseenter / mouseleave 与列、行标记。宿主记录当前行列，以 ASAM token 同时高亮整条可见行与该列所有可见单元格，离开单元格时清除。它与 layout-states 中仅跟踪行的悬停是两个完整用途，不改变虚拟滚动或选择逻辑。

跨行列悬停

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<section>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">
			{{
				hoveredRow < 0
					? '未悬停'
					: `悬停第 ${hoveredRow + 1} 行、第 ${hoveredColumn + 1} 列`
			}}
		</p>
		<AsamTableV2
			:columns="columns"
			:data="rows"
			:cell-props="cellProps"
			:width="600"
			:height="300"
			row-key="id"
		/>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2CrossHoveringDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamTableV2 } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableV2Columns, AsamTableV2ExtraCellPropGetter } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const columns: AsamTableV2Columns<string> = ['名称', '所属组', '说明'].map((title, index) => ({
	key: `value${index}`,
	dataKey: `value${index}`,
	title,
	width: 200
}));
const rows = Array.from({ length: 60 }, (_, id) => ({
	id,
	value0: `记录 ${id + 1}`,
	value1: `组 ${Math.floor(id / 5) + 1}`,
	value2: `说明 ${id + 1}`
}));
const hoveredRow = ref(-1);
const hoveredColumn = ref(-1);
const cellProps: AsamTableV2ExtraCellPropGetter<string> = ({ columnIndex, rowIndex }) => ({
	'data-column': columnIndex,
	'data-record': rowIndex,
	style: {
		backgroundColor:
			columnIndex === hoveredColumn.value || rowIndex === hoveredRow.value
				? 'var(--asam-color-primary-hover)'
				: undefined
	},
	onMouseenter: () => {
		hoveredRow.value = rowIndex;
		hoveredColumn.value = columnIndex;
	},
	onMouseleave: () => {
		hoveredRow.value = -1;
		hoveredColumn.value = -1;
	}
});
</script>

	<section>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">
			{{
				hoveredRow < 0
					? '未悬停'
					: `悬停第 ${hoveredRow + 1} 行、第 ${hoveredColumn + 1} 列`
			}}
		</p>
		<AsamTableV2
			:columns="columns"
			:data="rows"
			:cell-props="cellProps"
			:width="600"
			:height="300"
			row-key="id"
		/>
	</section>
</template>
<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2CrossHoveringJsDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamTableV2 } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const columns = ['名称', '所属组', '说明'].map((title, index) => ({
	key: `value${index}`,
	dataKey: `value${index}`,
	title,
	width: 200
}));
const rows = Array.from({ length: 60 }, (_, id) => ({
	id,
	value0: `记录 ${id + 1}`,
	value1: `组 ${Math.floor(id / 5) + 1}`,
	value2: `说明 ${id + 1}`
}));
const hoveredRow = ref(-1);
const hoveredColumn = ref(-1);
const cellProps = ({ columnIndex, rowIndex }) => ({
	'data-column': columnIndex,
	'data-record': rowIndex,
	style: {
		backgroundColor:
			columnIndex === hoveredColumn.value || rowIndex === hoveredRow.value
				? 'var(--asam-color-primary-hover)'
				: undefined
	},
	onMouseenter: () => {
		hoveredRow.value = rowIndex;
		hoveredColumn.value = columnIndex;
	},
	onMouseleave: () => {
		hoveredRow.value = -1;
		hoveredColumn.value = -1;
	}
});
</script>

单列 sortBy 受控排序 ​

sortBy 保存单个 { key, order }，示例在 column-sort 回调中回写此对象，并由宿主 computed 对数据副本排序。 完整说明。

单列 sortBy 受控排序

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<section>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">
			单列排序 {{ sortBy.key }}:{{ sortBy.order }}；首行 {{ displayed[0]?.name }}
		</p>
		<AsamTableV2
			:columns="columns"
			:data="displayed"
			:sort-by="sortBy"
			:width="500"
			:height="300"
			row-key="id"
			@column-sort="sort"
		/>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2SortByDemo' });
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamTableV2, AsamTableV2SortOrder } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamTableV2Columns,
	AsamTableV2ColumnSortParams,
	AsamTableV2SortBy
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

const columns: AsamTableV2Columns<unknown> = [
	{ key: 'name', dataKey: 'name', title: '名称', width: 300, sortable: true },
	{ key: 'count', dataKey: 'count', title: '数量', width: 200, sortable: true }
];
const rows = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, id) => ({
	id,
	name: `记录 ${id + 1}`,
	count: 12 - id
}));
const sortBy = ref<AsamTableV2SortBy>({ key: 'count', order: AsamTableV2SortOrder.ASC });
const displayed = computed(() => {
	const { key, order } = sortBy.value;
	return [...rows].sort((left, right) => {
		const difference =
			key === 'count'
				? left.count - right.count
				: left.name.localeCompare(right.name, 'zh-CN', { numeric: true });
		return order === AsamTableV2SortOrder.ASC ? difference : -difference;
	});
});
function sort({ key, order }: AsamTableV2ColumnSortParams<unknown>): void {
	// The host owns both the single-column descriptor and the displayed data.
	sortBy.value = { key, order: order ?? AsamTableV2SortOrder.ASC };
}
</script>

<style scoped>
p:where(.example-paragraph) {

	line-height: 1.8;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

随滚动切换吸顶组 ​

示例将 scroll 事件的 scrollTop 保存为宿主状态，根据显式 rowHeight 和分组记录数计算当前组，再通过 computed 更新 fixedData。 完整说明。

随滚动切换吸顶组

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<section class="ui037-sticky-scroll">
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="primary" @click="table?.scrollToTop(480)">
			定位第三组
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="default" @click="table?.scrollToTop(0)">
			返回首组
		</AsamButton>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">
			当前吸顶 {{ fixedData[0]?.name }}；滚动 {{ scrollTop }}
		</p>
		<AsamTableV2
			ref="table"
			:columns="columns"
			:data="rows.slice(1)"
			:fixed-data="fixedData"
			:row-height="rowHeight"
			:row-class="rowClass"
			:width="600"
			:height="300"
			row-key="id"
			@scroll="onScroll"
		/>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2StickyScrollDemo' });
import { computed, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamTableV2 } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamTableV2Columns,
	AsamTableV2Expose,
	AsamTableV2RowClassNameGetter
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

const columns: AsamTableV2Columns<unknown> = [
	{ key: 'name', dataKey: 'name', title: '名称', width: 220 },
	{ key: 'detail', dataKey: 'detail', title: '说明', width: 380 }
];
const groupLength = 6;
const rowHeight = 40;
const rows = Array.from({ length: 120 }, (_, id) => ({
	id,
	name: id % groupLength === 0 ? `第 ${id / groupLength + 1} 组` : `记录 ${id}`,
	detail: id % groupLength === 0 ? '滚动到下一组时替换此吸顶记录' : '普通记录'
}));
const table = shallowRef<AsamTableV2Expose>();
const scrollTop = ref(0);
const fixedData = computed(() => {
	const groupIndex = Math.min(
		Math.floor(scrollTop.value / (rowHeight * groupLength)),
		rows.length / groupLength - 1
	);
	return rows.slice(groupIndex * groupLength, groupIndex * groupLength + 1);
});
const rowClass: AsamTableV2RowClassNameGetter<unknown> = ({ rowIndex }) =>
	rowIndex < 0 ? 'ui037-active-sticky' : '';
function onScroll({ scrollTop: next }: { scrollTop: number }): void {
	scrollTop.value = next;
}
</script>
<style>
.ui037-sticky-scroll .ui037-active-sticky {
	background: var(--asam-color-primary-hover);
	font-weight: 600;
}
</style>

<style scoped>
p:where(.example-paragraph) {
	margin-block: 16px;
	line-height: 1.8;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

状态列的 headerCellRenderer 渲染本地 HeaderFilter SFC，由表头按钮打开原生 dialog。 完整说明。

表头 renderer 筛选（多文件）

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<section>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">
			表头筛选 {{ completedOnly ? '已完成' : '全部' }}；共 {{ displayed.length }} 行
		</p>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamTableV2
			:columns="columns"
			:data="displayed"
			:width="600"

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2HeaderFilterDemo' });
import { computed, h, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamTableV2 } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableV2Columns } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import HeaderFilter from './HeaderFilter.vue';

const completedOnly = ref(false);
const rows = Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, id) => ({
	id,
	name: `记录 ${id + 1}`,
	completed: id % 2 === 0,
	state: id % 2 === 0 ? '已完成' : '待处理'
}));
const displayed = computed(() => rows.filter((row) => !completedOnly.value || row.completed));
const columns: AsamTableV2Columns<unknown> = [
	{ key: 'name', dataKey: 'name', title: '名称', width: 350 },
	{
		key: 'state',
		dataKey: 'state',
		title: '状态',
		width: 250,
		headerCellRenderer: ({ column }) =>
			h(HeaderFilter, {
				title: String(column.title),
				enabled: completedOnly.value,
				onApply: (enabled: boolean) => {
					completedOnly.value = enabled;
				}
			})
	}
];
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamBaseForm } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamDialog, AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2HeaderFilter' });
import { ref } from 'vue';

const props = defineProps({
	title: { type: String, required: true },
	enabled: { type: Boolean, required: true }
});
const emit = defineEmits({ apply: (enabled: boolean) => typeof enabled === 'boolean' });
const dialogOpen = ref(false);
const draft = ref(false);
function open(): void {
	draft.value = props.enabled;
	dialogOpen.value = true;
}
function apply(enabled: boolean): void {
	emit('apply', enabled);
	dialogOpen.value = false;
}
</script>

<template>
	<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="merge">合并两行两列</AsamCheckboxItem>
	<label>
		合并方向
		<AsamSelect v-model="mode">
			<AsamOption value="both" :label="'行列同时合并'">行列同时合并</AsamOption>
			<AsamOption value="row" :label="'仅合并行'">仅合并行</AsamOption>

		row-key="id"
	>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2SpansDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamTableV2 } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableV2Columns, AsamTableV2ExtraCellPropGetter } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import RowRenderer from './RowRenderer.vue';
const merge = ref(true);
const mode = ref<'row' | 'column' | 'both'>('both');
const cellProps: AsamTableV2ExtraCellPropGetter<unknown> = ({ rowIndex, columnIndex }) => ({
	'data-merged':
		merge.value && rowIndex % 2 === 0 && columnIndex === 0
			? mode.value === 'both'
				? '2x2'
				: mode.value === 'row'
					? '2x1'
					: '1x2'
			: undefined
});
const columns: AsamTableV2Columns<unknown> = ['name', 'group', 'count', 'note'].map(
	(key, index) => ({
		key,
		dataKey: key,
		title: ['姓名', '分组', '数量', '备注'][index] ?? key,
		width: 140
	})
);
const rows = Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, id) => ({
	id,
	name: `合并记录 ${id + 1}`,
	group: `分组 ${Math.floor(id / 2)}`,
	count: id,
	note: '独立未合并列'
}));
</script>
vue
<template><RenderCells /></template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { cloneVNode } from 'vue';
import type { VNode } from 'vue';
const props = defineProps<{
	cells: VNode[];
	rowIndex: number;
	merge: boolean;
	mode: 'row' | 'column' | 'both';
}>();
const RenderCells = () => {
	const cells = [...props.cells];
	if (!props.merge) return cells;
	const mergeRow = props.mode !== 'column';
	const mergeColumn = props.mode !== 'row';
	if (!mergeRow || props.rowIndex % 2 === 0) {
		cells[0] = cloneVNode(cells[0], {
			style: {
				width: mergeColumn ? '280px' : '140px',
				height: mergeRow ? '87px' : '44px',
				alignSelf: 'flex-start',
				zIndex: 1,
				background: 'var(--asam-color-surface)',
				border: '1px solid var(--asam-color-border)'
			},
			'data-merged': '2x2'
		});
		if (mergeColumn) cells.splice(1, 1);
	} else {
		cells[0] = cloneVNode(cells[0], { style: { visibility: 'hidden' } });
		if (mergeColumn) cells[1] = cloneVNode(cells[1], { style: { visibility: 'hidden' } });
	}
	return cells;
};
</script>

const mode = ref('both');
const cellProps = ({ rowIndex, columnIndex }) => ({
	'data-merged':
		merge.value && rowIndex % 2 === 0 && columnIndex === 0
			? mode.value === 'both'
				? '2x2'
				: mode.value === 'row'
					? '2x1'
					: '1x2'
			: undefined
});
const columns = ['name', 'group', 'count', 'note'].map((key, index) => ({
	key,
	dataKey: key,
	title: ['姓名', '分组', '数量', '备注'][index] ?? key,
	width: 140
}));
const rows = Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, id) => ({
	id,
	name: `合并记录 ${id + 1}`,
	group: `分组 ${Math.floor(id / 2)}`,
	count: id,
	note: '独立未合并列'
}));
</script>
vue
<template><RenderCells /></template>
<script setup>
import { cloneVNode } from 'vue';
const props = defineProps({
	cells: { type: Array, required: true },
	rowIndex: { type: Number, required: true },
	merge: { type: Boolean, required: true },
	mode: { type: String, required: true }
});
const RenderCells = () => {
	const cells = [...props.cells];
	if (!props.merge) return cells;
	const mergeRow = props.mode !== 'column';
	const mergeColumn = props.mode !== 'row';
	if (!mergeRow || props.rowIndex % 2 === 0) {
		cells[0] = cloneVNode(cells[0], {
			style: {
				width: mergeColumn ? '280px' : '140px',
				height: mergeRow ? '87px' : '44px',
				alignSelf: 'flex-start',
				zIndex: 1,
				background: 'var(--asam-color-surface)',
				border: '1px solid var(--asam-color-border)'
			},
			'data-merged': '2x2'
		});
		if (mergeColumn) cells.splice(1, 1);
	} else {
		cells[0] = cloneVNode(cells[0], { style: { visibility: 'hidden' } });
		if (mergeColumn) cells[1] = cloneVNode(cells[1], { style: { visibility: 'hidden' } });
	}
	return cells;
};
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2TreeDynamicDemo' });
import { h, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamTableV2 } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableV2Columns } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import TreeCell from './TreeCell.vue';
import DetailRow from './DetailRow.vue';
interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	detail?: string;
	children?: Row[];
}
const rows = ref([
	{ id: 1, name: '父记录', children: [{ id: 2, name: '子记录', detail: '短详情。' }] },
	...Array.from({ length: 60 }, (_, index) => ({
		id: index + 10,
		name: `普通记录 ${index + 1}`,
		children: [] as Row[]
	}))
]);
const expanded = ref<number[]>([]);
// 2.14.7 measures variable rows on mount. Rebuild its height cache after content changes;
// the host retains both the tree data and controlled expansion keys.
const heightRevision = ref(0);
const columns: AsamTableV2Columns<unknown> = [
	{
		key: 'name',
		dataKey: 'name',
		title: '动态树与详情',
		width: 470,
		cellRenderer: ({ rowData }: { rowData: Row }) =>
			h(TreeCell, { name: rowData.name, detail: rowData.detail })
	},
	{ key: 'id', dataKey: 'id', title: 'ID', width: 100 }
];
function changeHeight(): void {
	const child = rows.value[0].children[0];
	child.detail = (child.detail?.length ?? 0) > 20 ? '短详情。' : '动态高度详情。'.repeat(30);
	heightRevision.value += 1;
}
function appendChild(): void {
	rows.value[0].children.push({ id: Date.now(), name: '新子记录', detail: '追加后仍保持展开。' });
	expanded.value = [1];
}
</script>

<template>
	<section class="component-project" data-demo-host>
		<label
			>演示场景<AsamSelect
				:model-value="selected"
				aria-label="演示场景"

					v-for="option in options"

	</section>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, defineAsyncComponent, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const options = [
	{ value: 'density/ts', label: '四档视觉尺寸与原生行高 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'density/js', label: '四档视觉尺寸与原生行高 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'basic/ts', label: '基础用法与状态 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'basic/js', label: '基础用法与状态 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'layout-states/ts', label: '固定与分组、排序过滤和状态组合 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'layout-states/js', label: '固定与分组、排序过滤和状态组合 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'renderers/ts', label: '选择与行内编辑（多文件） (TS)' },
	{ value: 'renderers/js', label: '选择与行内编辑（多文件） (JS)' },
	{ value: 'spans/ts', label: '行列合并（多文件） (TS)' },
	{ value: 'spans/js', label: '行列合并（多文件） (JS)' },
	{ value: 'tree-dynamic/ts', label: '动态树、详情与追加节点（多文件） (TS)' },
	{ value: 'tree-dynamic/js', label: '动态树、详情与追加节点（多文件） (JS)' },
	{ value: 'cross-hovering/ts', label: '跨行列悬停 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'cross-hovering/js', label: '跨行列悬停 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'sort-by/ts', label: '单列 sortBy 受控排序 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'sort-by/js', label: '单列 sortBy 受控排序 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'sticky-scroll/ts', label: '随滚动切换吸顶组 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'sticky-scroll/js', label: '随滚动切换吸顶组 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'header-filter/ts', label: '表头 renderer 筛选（多文件） (TS)' },
	{ value: 'header-filter/js', label: '表头 renderer 筛选（多文件） (JS)' }
] as const;
const scenarios = {
	'density/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/density/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'density/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/density/js/Demo.vue')),
	'basic/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/basic/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'basic/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/basic/js/Demo.vue')),
	'layout-states/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/layout-states/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'layout-states/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/layout-states/js/Demo.vue')),
	'renderers/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/renderers/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'renderers/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/renderers/js/Demo.vue')),
	'spans/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/spans/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'spans/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/spans/js/Demo.vue')),
	'tree-dynamic/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/tree-dynamic/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'tree-dynamic/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/tree-dynamic/js/Demo.vue')),
	'cross-hovering/ts': defineAsyncComponent(
		() => import('./examples/cross-hovering/ts/Demo.vue')
	),
	'cross-hovering/js': defineAsyncComponent(
		() => import('./examples/cross-hovering/js/Demo.vue')
	),
	'sort-by/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/sort-by/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'sort-by/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/sort-by/js/Demo.vue')),
	'sticky-scroll/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/sticky-scroll/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'sticky-scroll/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/sticky-scroll/js/Demo.vue')),
	'header-filter/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/header-filter/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'header-filter/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/header-filter/js/Demo.vue'))
};
const selected = shallowRef<keyof typeof scenarios>('density/ts');
function selectScenario(value: unknown) {
	const option = options.find((option) => option.value === value);
	if (option) selected.value = option.value;
}
const current = computed(() => scenarios[selected.value]);
</script>

vue
<template>
	<div class="demo-root-layout">
		<label>
			筛选名称
			<AsamInput v-model="query" />
		</label>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="empty">空数据</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="loading">显示覆盖层</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="primary" @click="compact = !compact">
			调整容器宽度
		</AsamButton>
		<div :style="{ width: compact ? '480px' : '640px', height: '340px', maxWidth: '100%' }">
			<AsamAutoResizer>
				<template #default="{ width, height }">
					<AsamTableV2
						:columns="columns"
						:data="empty ? [] : displayed"
						:fixed-data="empty ? [] : [sticky]"
						:width="width"
						:height="height"
						:header-height="[30, 40]"
						:footer-height="36"
						:sort-state="sortState"
						:row-event-handlers="rowEvents"
						:row-class="rowClass"
						row-key="id"
						@column-sort="sort"
						@scroll="scroll = `${$event.scrollTop}:${$event.scrollLeft}`"
						@end-reached="endReached++"
					>
						<template #header="scope"><GroupHeader v-bind="scope" /></template>
						<template #footer>
							<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">
								共 {{ displayed.length }} 行；滚动 {{ scroll }}；触底
								{{ endReached }}
								<span data-testid="v2-sort-source">
									最近排序请求 {{ lastSortRequest }}
								</span>
							</p>
						</template>
						<template #empty><p class="example-paragraph">没有匹配的记录</p></template>
						<template v-if="loading" #overlay>
							<div class="ui030-loading-overlay" role="status">正在加载本地记录</div>
						</template>
					</AsamTableV2>
				</template>
			</AsamAutoResizer>
		</div>
	</div>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2LayoutStatesDemo' });
import { computed, h, ref } from 'vue';
import type { FunctionalComponent } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamInput,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamAutoResizer,
	AsamTableV2,
	AsamTableV2FixedDir,
	AsamTableV2Placeholder,
	AsamTableV2SortOrder
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamTableV2Columns,
	AsamTableV2CustomizedHeaderSlotParam,
	AsamTableV2ColumnSortParams,
	AsamTableV2SortState,
	AsamTableV2RowEventHandlers,
	AsamTableV2RowClassNameGetter
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	count: number;
	detail: string;
}
const rows = ref<Row[]>(
	Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, id) => ({
		id,
		name: `记录 ${id + 1}`,
		count: 100 - id,
		detail: `记录 ${id + 1} 的完整说明`
	}))
);
const sticky: Row = { id: -1, name: '固定汇总行', count: 5050, detail: '始终位于表头下方' };
const columns: AsamTableV2Columns<unknown> = [
	{
		key: 'name',
		dataKey: 'name',
		title: '名称',
		width: 180,
		sortable: true,
		fixed: AsamTableV2FixedDir.LEFT
	},
	{ key: 'count', dataKey: 'count', title: '数量', width: 120, sortable: true },
	{ key: 'detail', dataKey: 'detail', title: '说明', width: 300 },
	{ key: 'id', dataKey: 'id', title: '编号', width: 100, fixed: AsamTableV2FixedDir.RIGHT }
];
const query = ref('');
const empty = ref(false);
const loading = ref(false);
const compact = ref(false);
const hovered = ref(-2);
const scroll = ref('0:0');
const endReached = ref(0);
const sortState = ref<AsamTableV2SortState>({});
const lastSortRequest = ref('未触发');
const displayed = computed(() => rows.value.filter((row) => row.name.includes(query.value)));
function sort({ key, order }: AsamTableV2ColumnSortParams<unknown>): void {
	lastSortRequest.value = `${String(key)}:${String(order)}`;
	// Native 2.14.7 can emit undefined for a column absent from controlled sortState.
	const nextOrder = order ?? AsamTableV2SortOrder.ASC;
	sortState.value = { [key]: nextOrder };
	rows.value.sort((a, b) => {
		const difference =
			key === 'count'
				? a.count - b.count
				: a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'zh-CN', { numeric: true });
		return nextOrder === AsamTableV2SortOrder.ASC ? difference : -difference;
	});
}
const rowEvents: AsamTableV2RowEventHandlers = {
	onMouseenter: ({ rowIndex }) => {
		hovered.value = rowIndex;
	},
	onMouseleave: () => {
		hovered.value = -2;
	}
};
const rowClass: AsamTableV2RowClassNameGetter<unknown> = ({ rowIndex }) =>
	rowIndex === hovered.value ? 'ui030-hovered' : rowIndex % 2 ? 'ui030-striped' : '';
const GroupHeader: FunctionalComponent<AsamTableV2CustomizedHeaderSlotParam> = ({
	cells,
	columns: current,
	headerIndex
}) => {
	if (headerIndex === 1) return cells;
	return current.map((column, index) =>
		column.placeholderSign === AsamTableV2Placeholder
			? cells[index]
			: h(
					'div',
					{ class: 'el-table-v2__header-cell', style: { width: `${column.width}px` } },
					column.fixed ? '固定区' : '记录信息'
				)
	);
};
</script>

}

.ui030-striped {

</style>

<style scoped>

</style>

	margin-block: 16px;

	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

						:fixed-data="empty ? [] : [sticky]"
						:width="width"
						:height="height"

						:footer-height="36"

						:row-event-handlers="rowEvents"
						:row-class="rowClass"
						row-key="id"

						@end-reached="endReached++"
					>
						<template #header="scope"><GroupHeader v-bind="scope" /></template>
						<template #footer>
							<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">
								共 {{ displayed.length }} 行；滚动 {{ scroll }}；触底
								{{ endReached }}
								<span data-testid="v2-sort-source">

						<template #empty><p class="example-paragraph">没有匹配的记录</p></template>
						<template v-if="loading" #overlay>
							<div class="ui030-loading-overlay" role="status">正在加载本地记录</div>
						</template>

			</AsamAutoResizer>
		</div>
	</div>
</template>
<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2LayoutStatesDemo' });
import { computed, h, ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamInput,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamAutoResizer,
	AsamTableV2,
	AsamTableV2FixedDir,
	AsamTableV2Placeholder,
	AsamTableV2SortOrder
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const rows = ref(
	Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, id) => ({
		id,
		name: `记录 ${id + 1}`,
		count: 100 - id,
		detail: `记录 ${id + 1} 的完整说明`
	}))
);
const sticky = { id: -1, name: '固定汇总行', count: 5050, detail: '始终位于表头下方' };
const columns = [
	{
		key: 'name',
		dataKey: 'name',
		title: '名称',
		width: 180,
		sortable: true,
		fixed: AsamTableV2FixedDir.LEFT
	},
	{ key: 'count', dataKey: 'count', title: '数量', width: 120, sortable: true },
	{ key: 'detail', dataKey: 'detail', title: '说明', width: 300 },
	{ key: 'id', dataKey: 'id', title: '编号', width: 100, fixed: AsamTableV2FixedDir.RIGHT }
];
const query = ref('');
const empty = ref(false);
const loading = ref(false);
const compact = ref(false);
const hovered = ref(-2);
const scroll = ref('0:0');
const endReached = ref(0);
const sortState = ref({});
const lastSortRequest = ref('未触发');
const displayed = computed(() => rows.value.filter((row) => row.name.includes(query.value)));
function sort({ key, order }) {
	lastSortRequest.value = `${String(key)}:${String(order)}`;
	// Native 2.14.7 can emit undefined for a column absent from controlled sortState.
	const nextOrder = order ?? AsamTableV2SortOrder.ASC;
	sortState.value = { [key]: nextOrder };
	rows.value.sort((a, b) => {
		const difference =
			key === 'count'
				? a.count - b.count
				: a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'zh-CN', { numeric: true });
		return nextOrder === AsamTableV2SortOrder.ASC ? difference : -difference;
	});
}
const rowEvents = {
	onMouseenter: ({ rowIndex }) => {
		hovered.value = rowIndex;
	},
	onMouseleave: () => {
		hovered.value = -2;
	}
};
const rowClass = ({ rowIndex }) =>
	rowIndex === hovered.value ? 'ui030-hovered' : rowIndex % 2 ? 'ui030-striped' : '';
const GroupHeader = ({ cells, columns: current, headerIndex }) => {
	if (headerIndex === 1) return cells;
	return current.map((column, index) =>
		column.placeholderSign === AsamTableV2Placeholder
			? cells[index]
			: h(
					'div',
					{ class: 'el-table-v2__header-cell', style: { width: `${column.width}px` } },
					column.fixed ? '固定区' : '记录信息'
				)
	);
};
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2RenderersDemo' });
import { computed, h, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamTableV2, AsamTableV2FixedDir } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableV2Columns, AsamTableV2Expose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import SelectionCell from './SelectionCell.vue';
import EditorCell from './EditorCell.vue';
import type { Row } from './Row.js';
const rows = ref<Row[]>(
	Array.from({ length: 200 }, (_, id) => ({
		id,
		name: `记录 ${id + 1}`,
		checked: false,
		editing: false
	}))
);
const table = ref<AsamTableV2Expose>();
const drafts = new Map<number, string>();
const columns = computed<AsamTableV2Columns<unknown>>(() => [
	{
		key: 'selection',
		width: 60,
		fixed: AsamTableV2FixedDir.LEFT,
		headerCellRenderer: () =>
			h(SelectionCell, {
				label: '选择所有记录',
				checked: rows.value.every((row) => row.checked),
				indeterminate:
					rows.value.some((row) => row.checked) &&
					!rows.value.every((row) => row.checked),
				onChange: (checked: boolean) =>
					rows.value.forEach((row) => {
						row.checked = checked;
					})
			}),
		cellRenderer: ({ rowData }: { rowData: Row }) =>
			h(SelectionCell, {
				label: `选择记录 ${rowData.id + 1}`,
				checked: rowData.checked,
				onChange: (checked: boolean) => {
					rowData.checked = checked;
				}
			})
	},
	{
		key: 'name',
		dataKey: 'name',
		title: '名称（点击编辑）',
		width: 360,
		cellRenderer: ({ rowData }: { rowData: Row }) =>
			h(EditorCell, {
				label: `编辑记录 ${rowData.id + 1}`,
				value: rowData.name,
				editing: rowData.editing,
				onStart: () => {
					drafts.set(rowData.id, rowData.name);
					rowData.editing = true;
				},
				onChange: (value: string) => {
					rowData.name = value;
				},
				onFinish: () => {
					rowData.editing = false;
					drafts.delete(rowData.id);
				},
				onCancel: () => {
					rowData.name = drafts.get(rowData.id) ?? rowData.name;
					rowData.editing = false;
					drafts.delete(rowData.id);
				}
			})
	},
	{ key: 'id', dataKey: 'id', title: '稳定行键', width: 140 }
]);
</script>

	})
);

	id,
	name: `合并记录 ${id + 1}`,
	group: `分组 ${Math.floor(id / 2)}`,
	count: id,
	note: '独立未合并列'
}));

vue
<template><RenderCells /></template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { cloneVNode } from 'vue';
import type { VNode } from 'vue';
const props = defineProps<{
	cells: VNode[];
	rowIndex: number;
	merge: boolean;
	mode: 'row' | 'column' | 'both';
}>();
const RenderCells = () => {
	const cells = [...props.cells];
	if (!props.merge) return cells;
	const mergeRow = props.mode !== 'column';
	const mergeColumn = props.mode !== 'row';
	if (!mergeRow || props.rowIndex % 2 === 0) {
		cells[0] = cloneVNode(cells[0], {
			style: {
				width: mergeColumn ? '280px' : '140px',
				height: mergeRow ? '87px' : '44px',
				alignSelf: 'flex-start',
				zIndex: 1,
				background: 'var(--asam-color-surface)',
				border: '1px solid var(--asam-color-border)'
			},
			'data-merged': '2x2'
		});
		if (mergeColumn) cells.splice(1, 1);
	} else {
		cells[0] = cloneVNode(cells[0], { style: { visibility: 'hidden' } });
		if (mergeColumn) cells[1] = cloneVNode(cells[1], { style: { visibility: 'hidden' } });
	}
	return cells;
};
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2SortByDemo' });
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamTableV2, AsamTableV2SortOrder } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamTableV2Columns,
	AsamTableV2ColumnSortParams,
	AsamTableV2SortBy
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

const columns: AsamTableV2Columns<unknown> = [
	{ key: 'name', dataKey: 'name', title: '名称', width: 300, sortable: true },
	{ key: 'count', dataKey: 'count', title: '数量', width: 200, sortable: true }
];
const rows = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, id) => ({
	id,
	name: `记录 ${id + 1}`,
	count: 12 - id
}));
const sortBy = ref<AsamTableV2SortBy>({ key: 'count', order: AsamTableV2SortOrder.ASC });
const displayed = computed(() => {
	const { key, order } = sortBy.value;
	return [...rows].sort((left, right) => {
		const difference =
			key === 'count'
				? left.count - right.count
				: left.name.localeCompare(right.name, 'zh-CN', { numeric: true });
		return order === AsamTableV2SortOrder.ASC ? difference : -difference;
	});
});
function sort({ key, order }: AsamTableV2ColumnSortParams<unknown>): void {
	// The host owns both the single-column descriptor and the displayed data.
	sortBy.value = { key, order: order ?? AsamTableV2SortOrder.ASC };
}
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2StickyScrollDemo' });
import { computed, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamTableV2 } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamTableV2Columns,
	AsamTableV2Expose,
	AsamTableV2RowClassNameGetter
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

const columns: AsamTableV2Columns<unknown> = [
	{ key: 'name', dataKey: 'name', title: '名称', width: 220 },
	{ key: 'detail', dataKey: 'detail', title: '说明', width: 380 }
];
const groupLength = 6;
const rowHeight = 40;
const rows = Array.from({ length: 120 }, (_, id) => ({
	id,
	name: id % groupLength === 0 ? `第 ${id / groupLength + 1} 组` : `记录 ${id}`,
	detail: id % groupLength === 0 ? '滚动到下一组时替换此吸顶记录' : '普通记录'
}));
const table = shallowRef<AsamTableV2Expose>();
const scrollTop = ref(0);
const fixedData = computed(() => {
	const groupIndex = Math.min(
		Math.floor(scrollTop.value / (rowHeight * groupLength)),
		rows.length / groupLength - 1
	);
	return rows.slice(groupIndex * groupLength, groupIndex * groupLength + 1);
});
const rowClass: AsamTableV2RowClassNameGetter<unknown> = ({ rowIndex }) =>
	rowIndex < 0 ? 'ui037-active-sticky' : '';
function onScroll({ scrollTop: next }: { scrollTop: number }): void {
	scrollTop.value = next;
}
</script>

	}

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamBaseForm } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamDialog, AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableV2HeaderFilter' });
import { ref } from 'vue';

const props = defineProps({
	title: { type: String, required: true },
	enabled: { type: Boolean, required: true }
});
const emit = defineEmits({ apply: (enabled: boolean) => typeof enabled === 'boolean' });
const dialogOpen = ref(false);
const draft = ref(false);
function open(): void {
	draft.value = props.enabled;
	dialogOpen.value = true;
}
function apply(enabled: boolean): void {
	emit('apply', enabled);
	dialogOpen.value = false;
}
</script>

import { computed, h, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamTableV2 } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import HeaderFilter from './HeaderFilter.vue';
const completedOnly = ref(false);
const rows = Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, id) => ({
	id,
	name: `记录 ${id + 1}`,
	completed: id % 2 === 0,
	state: id % 2 === 0 ? '已完成' : '待处理'
}));
const displayed = computed(() => rows.filter((row) => !completedOnly.value || row.completed));
const columns = [
	{ key: 'name', dataKey: 'name', title: '名称', width: 350 },
	{
		key: 'state',
		dataKey: 'state',
		title: '状态',
		width: 250,
		headerCellRenderer: ({ column }) =>

				title: String(column.title),
				enabled: completedOnly.value,
				onApply: (enabled) => {
					completedOnly.value = enabled;
				}
			})
	}
];
</script>

# AsamTableV2 全部场景

Node22.19+的22.x、pnpm11.9.0。在本目录执行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run dev、pnpm run build。vendor为固定正常包，保留锁文件和patches，不引用网站源码或借用node_modules。

界面中的场景选择器列出本组件全部真实TS/JS用法。src/examples/<场景>/<语言>/保留各场景原文件名、相对导入和资产；文件没有拼接进Demo.vue。主入口与所有场景配置也在文档的完整工程文件面板中。选择另一个场景会卸载前一个实例；文档中只切源文件则不会重挂载。

演示许可与第三方说明位于LICENSE、THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md及来源文件同目录的LICENSE-<摘要>.txt。

## Component compatibility sources and build helpers

Cascader, Image, ImageViewer and Anchor delegate their basic public behavior to
the installed Element Plus 2.14.7 components. ASAM supplies its styles and
documented advanced value adapters; it does not carry derived setup/render
implementations, bounded zoom, keyboard focus patches or Anchor scroll handling.

The former compatibility implementations used Element Plus gitHead
`77d5c32c4ebcfffde67e51f6325c6d350ca668a0`. Their original source identities
are retained here for historical provenance: the Cascader distribution module
SHA256 was `bac94ed4602841106d134f39056fdaca0d7fbb711fc8ff4339b7fac65391ea82`;
Anchor source `packages/components/anchor/src/anchor.vue` SHA256 was
`3a60f68d455f3e582ecffd4639c78ee24fcbf0a2bcfe0ce0cddf03583d78af2f`.
These historical identities do not imply that the derived runtime remains in
this native-delegation candidate. The original Element Plus license follows.

Build helper inputs are pinned to VueUse core 15.0.0, Element Plus Icons Vue
2.3.2 and Lodash ES 4.18.1. Other components may still use these helpers;
removing the four derived implementations does not remove their notices.
VueUse shared and metadata 15.0.0 carry the same license text as core. The
following original notices remain applicable to retained source and helper
inputs; the installed Element Plus components and Vue remain peer dependencies.

## Private declaration snapshots

The normal declaration build redistributes 590 Element Plus 2.14.7 ES declarations
and 295 Element Plus Icons Vue 2.3.2 declarations under `dist/_upstream`.
The original declaration and producer-patch hashes, module-path adaptations and
output hashes are recorded in `dist/_upstream/provenance.json` and the build input
`tools/eng-006/upstream-declarations.lock.json`. The fixed Element Plus source
identity is `77d5c32c4ebcfffde67e51f6325c6d350ca668a0`.

Eight Element Plus declarations receive the recorded strong-type corrections.
Relative declaration references use explicit NodeNext extensions. The Color
class, installation key, table placeholder key and loading directive declaration
are exact re-exports of the original peer declaration leaves, preserving private
member and unique-symbol identity. These snapshots have no runtime entry point.

The complete original MIT licenses are redistributed with each declaration
snapshot at `dist/_upstream/element-plus/LICENSE` and
`dist/_upstream/icons-vue/LICENSE`. The Element Plus and Icons Vue copyright and
license texts above also apply to these declaration derivatives. External type
providers remain normal installed dependencies; their declarations are not
copied into these snapshots.

用法与契约补充说明 ​

契约与组合 ​

columns 是渲染列定义，data 是宿主数据；width / height 必须是实际视窗尺寸。可用 AsamAutoResizer 观测有明确高度的父容器。基础固定行高用 rowHeight，动态行高用 estimatedRowHeight；2.14.7 在行挂载时测量实际高度；详情内容长度改变时，示例以 key 重建高度缓存，宿主继续保留数据与展开键。size 可选 large / big / default / small，未传时从最近的 ASAM 尺寸作用域继承，只负责品牌视觉标记；原生 rowHeight / headerHeight 默认值与显式值保持原样，尺寸不会替换业务内容的实际视窗约束。

契约与组合 ​

此入口渲染公开 原生虚拟表格，透传全部原生 props、监听器和 slots，并通过公开 ref 转发实例方法与 live 对象。ASAM 只增加 asam-table-v2 类和 data-asam-size，不调用私有 setup、不改写返回 VNode，也不引入原生缓存补丁。与原生相同，未传参数和显式 undefined / null / false 由原生默认值及校验处理。

契约与组合 ​

选择、编辑、过滤、排序、合并与动态树由 renderer / slots 和宿主状态组合承接。选择示例提供全选、半选表头和逐行选择；编辑提供开始、输入、Enter/失焦提交和 Escape 取消，并将单元格拆成独立文件。固定列、固定汇总行、分组表头、受控排序、宿主过滤、行状态与悬停、footer / empty / overlay 可以在同一真实入口组合。

契约与组合 ​

合并使用 row slot 的 cells，复制 VNode 后设置宽高；不要改传入的 cells。合并行应连续，并避免合并跨过虚拟视窗边界导致部分内容不可见；示例保留其他未合并列。树数据提供 children 和稳定 rowKey，通过 expandedRowKeys / expandColumnKey 控制展开；动态详情和追加节点由宿主更新实际树。

契约与组合 ​

scrollTo / scrollToLeft / scrollToTop / scrollToRow 是公开滚动方法。边界实例示例可到达最后一行并返回起点。column-sort / expanded-rows-change / row-expand / rows-rendered / scroll / end-reached 提供组合状态；排序和过滤由宿主更新 data，不在 computed 中修改传入数据。

组合能力与类型 ​

第一列复选框通过 cellRenderer 与宿主选择状态组合，renderers 完整示例同时包含表头全选及半选；不要假定 TableV2 自带 Table 的选择列注册机制。虚拟入口将选择、编辑、合并和过滤留给公开 renderer/slots 与宿主组合，本文对应多文件示例提供这些实际功能。原生 TableV2 的列、行、单元格、表头、排序和事件回调基础类型均从本入口 Types.ts 的具名 AsamTableV2 别名承接；生成的根出口由 ENG-006 提供，业务 Row 与单元格值类型应按各回调真实契约区分。

原生 slot 与声明边界 ​

原生实例 $props 类型未声明 onUpdate:expandedRowKeys 监听器键，运行时仍会触发 update:expandedRowKeys。这项声明限制仅描述 $props 类型的键缺失，不能据此判定模板 v-model:expanded-row-keys 不受支持；完整 TS 示例保留该模板绑定，类型检查与实际更新行为以消费项目的同配置编译和运行结果为准。

单列 sortBy 受控排序 ​

sortBy 保存单个 { key, order }，示例在 column-sort 回调中回写此对象，并由宿主 computed 对数据副本排序。点击同列切换方向，切换列替换当前排序键；2.14.7 切换列时也根据当前 sortBy.order 翻转方向，宿主采用真实回调 order。layout-states 的 sortState 列映射仍作为另一种受控方式保留。

随滚动切换吸顶组 ​

示例将 scroll 事件的 scrollTop 保存为宿主状态，根据显式 rowHeight 和分组记录数计算当前组，再通过 computed 更新 fixedData。正常滚动、公开 scrollToTop 定位第三组和返回首组都驱动同一转换。这是随滚动变化的吸顶记录，与 layout-states 的恒定汇总行分别演示；动态行高应由宿主提供适合其数据的分组定位策略。

表头 renderer 筛选（多文件） ​

状态列的 headerCellRenderer 渲染本地 HeaderFilter SFC，由表头按钮打开原生 dialog。草稿选择只在确认时写回宿主，取消保留现有筛选，重置恢复全部记录；宿主 computed 更新展示数据。dialog 位于浏览器顶层，不依赖其他组件卡的浮层，也不接管表格内部筛选算法。TS / JS 变体均列出并提供入口与辅助文件。

更多参数与事件说明 ​

受控排序与覆盖层 ​

固定2.14.7在 sortState 未包含被点击列时，首次 column-sort 的 order 可能为 undefined；本入口的 ColumnSortParams、ColumnSortHandler、Props / PropsPublic、Expose / Instance 的 $props 与实际组件监听器使用同一排序约束，均保留这一真实分支。layout-states 宿主示例首次缺失顺序采用 ASC，再保存有效顺序；之后真实点击切换升降序。覆盖层以 <template v-if="loading" #overlay> 控制插槽本身；仅在插槽内部隐藏内容仍会保留拦截点击的空覆盖层。
